source_text: The ANRS 1265 trial (2005), involving 3,274 uncircumcised men in South Africa aged 18–24, reported a 60% relative risk reduction (hazard ratio 0.40, 95% CI 0.24–0.68) after 21 months of follow-up, with similar findings in Ugandan (Rakai trial, 60% reduction) and Kenyan RCTs conducted between 2005 and 2007. [52]
